productDescription_en:
The Chrome Steel Tube – Stock Series 50×3 is a high‑quality precision tube designed for demanding mechanical and hydraulic applications. Manufactured from chrome‑alloy steel, this tube offers excellent strength, wear resistance, and dimensional stability, making it suitable for both standard stock use and further machining.

With an outer diameter of 50 mm and a wall thickness of 3 mm, the tube provides an optimal balance between mechanical performance and weight. The chrome steel composition ensures reliable operation under high pressure, repeated load cycles, and challenging industrial environments.

This stock series tube is commonly used in mechanical engineering, hydraulic systems, construction equipment, and general industrial applications, where consistent material quality and tight tolerances are required. Supplied in standard stock lengths, it enables fast availability and efficient integration into production or maintenance workflows.

Key benefits

High mechanical strength and durability
Good wear and fatigue resistance
Suitable for hydraulic and mechanical use
Consistent stock quality for repeatable performance
Ideal for machining and further processing
